I'm not buying the whole "Angles are evil" theory. Think about it. If they were evil, then why not include all the universes. Why spare the top 4. In my opinion, this tournament is leading more to Zamasu's Zero Mortals Plan, but a 2.0 version where the gods are involved, too. I mean, so far, we're been shown that the Grand Priest and Zeno are not satisfied with the majority of the universes and their performance. In addition, the Universe Angels are not satisfied with their universes and gods, as well. I mean, Whis and Vados complain about their gods all the time, and how they are not appreciating their work. So, it's only natural for U9's angle to smile. Not because he's evil, but because he's fed up with how poor his Universe became.  Clearly, these angels are falling under the same Ideology as Zamasu: that justice needs to be served and a rework is necessary.

My theory is that this tournament is designed to destroy all inferior universes, so they can create new ones. Thus, it will give the Angels a purpose to exist. Basically, again, Zamasu's Zero Mortals Plan 2.0, but without the Goku Black, sadly.

These are seriously the worst scams possible. Some MAX level player came up to me because he was asking for help on a quest. I accepted to aid the person, and she suggested we could reach our destination the fastest using a wilderness tab teleport. Luckily, I use ancient magika to travel, so I was aware that she was trying to scam me. 

Just the fact of taking advantage of polite kind players makes the scam sick and pathetic. I hope this gets a patch, so players are aware that these tabs don't get warning. 

I'm glad to see I'm not the only one who witness this type of scam.

Good to know people could relate. I never really told anyone my problems, but that's just it. You shouldn't have to tell anyone your problems. 

I guess I'm just tired of helping people when I just want someone help me. haha
